target.title: fix(ui): keep event payload previews UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users viewing the Overview event log would see a broken payload preview when the 120-character preview boundary landed inside an emoji or another UTF-16 surrogate pair.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Overview event payload previews now go through a dedicated presenter formatter before rendering.
- The presenter formatter uses the canonical `@openclaw/normalization-core/utf16-slice` truncator, so the UI shares the same surrogate-safe truncation contract used elsewhere.
- Full debug payload rendering, payload data, API/schema, and event storage are unchanged.

## User Impact

Overview event payload previews remain bounded and no longer display malformed emoji or replacement characters when event payloads contain astral Unicode characters near the preview boundary.

## Evidence

- Branch base checked during freshness gate: latest `origin/main` at `201acd4e7a4ad65c8ed58847e81914899a50b13e` still uses `formatEventPayload(entry.payload).slice(0, 120)` in `ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.ts`. No final rebase was performed.
- Real behavior proof:
  - **Behavior or issue addressed:** Overview event payload previews could split an emoji surrogate pair at the 120-code-unit boundary.
  - **Real environment tested:** macOS 26.5.2, Node v24.15.0, OpenClaw package v2026.6.11, worktree SHA `5b5ebe9`.
  - **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
    ```bash
    corepack pnpm@11.2.2 install
    corepack pnpm@11.2.2 exec playwright install chromium
    # Browser proof: start the Vite Control UI, install the mock Gateway WebSocket,
    # open /overview in Chromium, emit an agent.message event whose legacy 120-code-unit
    # preview ends on a high surrogate, then read .ov-event-log-payload from the DOM.
    corepack pnpm@11.2.2 test ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.test.ts
    node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.test.ui.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/test-ui.tsbuildinfo
    corepack pnpm@11.2.2 exec oxfmt --check ui/src/lib/presenter.ts ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.ts ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.test.ts
    corepack pnpm@11.2.2 exec oxlint --deny=warn --ignore-path=.oxlintignore ui/src/lib/presenter.ts ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.ts ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.test.ts
    git diff --check
    ```
  - **Evidence after fix:**
    ```text
    {
      "browserPath": "/overview",
      "legacySliceLastCodeUnit": 55357,
      "legacyEndsWithHighSurrogate": true,
      "previewLength": 119,
      "previewLastCodeUnit": 97,
      "previewEndsWithHighSurrogate": false,
      "previewTail": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
    }
    ```
  - **Observed result after fix:** the legacy raw slice still demonstrates the bad boundary, while the rendered Overview DOM preview backs off to 119 code units and ends on ordinary `a` (`97`), not a dangling surrogate.
  - **What was not tested:** full gateway daemon startup was not needed for this UI-only rendering path; the Control UI browser runtime was exercised with a Gateway event frame.
- Regression tests and local checks:
  ```text
  $ corepack pnpm@11.2.2 test ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.test.ts
  Test Files  1 passed (1)
       Tests  1 passed (1)
    Duration  542ms

  $ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.test.ui.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/test-ui.tsbuildinfo
  exit 0

  $ corepack pnpm@11.2.2 exec oxfmt --check ui/src/lib/presenter.ts ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.ts ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.test.ts
  Checking formatting...
  All matched files use the correct format.

  $ corepack pnpm@11.2.2 exec oxlint --deny=warn --ignore-path=.oxlintignore ui/src/lib/presenter.ts ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.ts ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.test.ts
  exit 0

  $ git diff --check
  exit 0
  ```

## Regression Test Plan

- Coverage level: Unit test plus browser runtime proof
- Target test file: `ui/src/pages/overview/event-log.test.ts`
- Scenario locked in: rendering an Overview event payload whose legacy 120-code-unit preview ends on the high surrogate of an emoji
- Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail: it exercises the same Overview renderer and payload formatting boundary without changing event storage or debug payload rendering.

## Root Cause

- Root cause: the Overview event log rendered `formatEventPayload(entry.payload).slice(0, 120)`, which truncates by raw UTF-16 code units and can leave a dangling surrogate when the boundary falls inside an emoji.
- Missing detection / guardrail: there was no Overview regression test covering surrogate-pair truncation at the preview boundary, and the initial repair duplicated truncation logic instead of reusing the canonical helper.
